transcript: Building a landing page for my coffee shop and check it before publishing.

steps.reason: Establish the shop facts, build format and acceptance checks without inventing business details.
steps.notes: Check the executing AI’s own authorized session context for existing facts and artifacts before asking questions. Produce coffee-shop-brief.md with sourced shop name, address, hours, menu/prices if displayed, contact details, primary CTA and destination, available licensed assets, and delivery format. Record missing facts as required inputs; ask only for material blockers. References are optional. Define mobile, accessibility, factual accuracy and working-link checks. Reuse any current supplied brief rather than recreating it.

steps.reason: Create coffee-shop-specific page copy and a practical layout focused on the agreed visitor action.
steps.notes: Use coffee-shop-brief.md to produce landing-page-copy.md and page-layout.md. Include a clear hero and CTA, verified menu highlights, and location/hours/contact sections where facts are available. Use only substantiated differentiators and supplied testimonials; omit unsupported awards, reviews and claims. Describe image needs without inventing assets. Keep optional reference influence to design principles, not copied text. Pass both files and the source brief to the builder.

steps.reason: Turn the agreed copy and layout into an actual lightweight, responsive page rather than only a design proposal.
steps.notes: Consume coffee-shop-brief.md, landing-page-copy.md and page-layout.md. Default to index.html, styles.css and assets/ plus README.md with local preview and hosting instructions; honor any confirmed platform requirement before building. Use semantic HTML, visible keyboard focus, suitable contrast, responsive images and mobile layouts. Implement the verified CTA destination; do not add unconfigured ordering, booking or form submission. Keep unresolved placeholders explicitly marked as publication blockers. Create a local preview if authorized tooling is available; do not deploy.

steps.reason: Check the built page before publication, including real interactions and layout where browser tooling is available.
steps.notes: Review index.html, styles.css, assets/, coffee-shop-brief.md, landing-page-copy.md and page-layout.md against the local preview. Write prepublish-qa.md with mobile/desktop checks, keyboard navigation, headings, contrast, image alternatives, overflow, asset loading and CTA/link behavior. Reconcile displayed hours, address, prices and claims with the brief. Record reproduction steps and actual evidence or screenshots for tested issues; distinguish code inspection from browser tests and mark unavailable tests unverified. Rank publication blockers separately from improvements.

steps.reason: Repair bounded failures, explicitly recheck changes and package an honest pre-publication handoff.
steps.notes: Consume coffee-shop-brief.md, landing-page-copy.md, page-layout.md, prepublish-qa.md and all built files. Perform at most two targeted fix-and-recheck passes, preserving the agreed scope. Recheck affected interactions and layouts using available tools; log results in final-check.md and changes in CHANGELOG.md. Leave missing facts or unavailable tests unresolved rather than claiming a pass. Update README.md with final file inventory, preview instructions, known limitations and hosting handoff. State ready for owner review or blocked, with reasons. Require owner confirmation of business facts and concrete authorization before any publishing.

assumptions: No existing page or source files were supplied, so this is a new build rather than an existing-page audit.
Plain HTML/CSS is the proposed delivery format unless the user specifies a platform or an authorized existing project establishes one.
Shop identity, location, hours, primary visitor action and its destination must be supplied or confirmed before a publication-ready page can be completed.
Reference sites or screenshots are optional. Browser testing depends on tools actually available to the executing AI; unavailable checks must remain explicitly unverified.
This workflow prepares and checks the page but does not authorize deployment, publishing, paid assets or external service configuration.

bindings.instruction: Combine the earlier page copy, design direction and original brief into the implementation brief. Preserve offer facts and all constraints.
Build and render the generated source in a compatible local preview. Use the preview URL or captured page for this check. If rendering is unavailable, stop this check and report it as not run.

Collect all earlier generated artifact files into an artifact-index.md document with file paths, requirement IDs and original formats. Read those files alongside the index; do not substitute the index for inspecting deliverables. Mark any missing artifact or unsupported format unresolved.

checks: Actual live UI microphone entered recording state and timer counted down
Live UI displayed returned transcription and success message
Transcript was submitted to live AI composition with normal signed-in session
Generated result is tailored to coffee-shop page creation and pre-publication QA
All five blocks rendered in live graph
Downloaded ZIP preserves exact transcript, AI plan, handoff instructions and all five skill files
Build-to-browser-check handoff explicitly requires rendered preview
scope: One real user-spoken request verifies this complete live path. Prior thirty-case evaluation covers broader routing separately; this test is not a universal speech or request guarantee.
